name: Herod Agrippa II
bio: King Agrippa (Herod Agrippa II), son of Herod Agrippa I, came with his sister Bernice to Caesarea to greet the new governor Festus; when Festus explained Paul's case, Agrippa asked to hear Paul himself, and the next day, with great pomp, he and Bernice entered the hall to hear Paul's defense (Acts 25:13-27). He is a different figure from his father, Herod Agrippa I, who had earlier persecuted the church and imprisoned Peter. His further role in questioning Paul is told in the chapters ahead.
